23640-little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-th.creator: Elbert Hubbard
23640-little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-th.description: A book by Elbert Hubbard. working to assist, did right royally disparage and condemn. Like sailors who love their ship, and grumble at grub and grog, yet on shore will allow no word of disparagement to be said, so did these Athenians love their city, and still condemn its rulers--they exercised the laborer's right to damn the man who gives him work.

38965-mater-christi-meditations-on-our-l.title: Meditations On Our Lady
38965-mater-christi-meditations-on-our-l.creator: Unknown
38965-mater-christi-meditations-on-our-l.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. O Holy Ghost, give me a great devotion and a great attraction towards Mary, Thy spouse; a great support in her maternal bosom, and an abiding refuge in her mercy; so that in her and by her Thou mayest form in me JESUS Christ.

arxiv-1606-01167.title: How Deep is the Feature Analysis underlying Rapid Visual Categorization?
arxiv-1606-01167.creator: Sven Eberhardt Jonah Cader Thomas Serre
arxiv-1606-01167.description: Abstract Rapid categorization paradigms have a long history in experimental psychology: Characterized by short presentation times and speedy behavioral responses, these tasks highlight the efficiency with which our visual system processes natural object categories. Previous studies have shown that feed-forward hierarchical models of the visual cortex provide a good fit to human visual decisions.

arxiv-2202-07195.title: Exact Hopfion Vortices in a 3D Heisenberg Ferromagnet
arxiv-2202-07195.creator: Radha Balakrishnan, Rossen Dandoloff, Avadh Saxena
arxiv-2202-07195.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Radha Balakrishnan, Rossen Dandoloff, Avadh Saxena. We find exact static soliton solutions for the unit spin vector field of an inhomogeneous, anisotropic three-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet. Each soliton is labeled by two integers n n and m m . It is a (modified) skyrmion in the z = 0 z=0 plane with winding number n n , which twists out of the plane m m times in the z z -direction to become a 3D soliton.

arxiv-2203-01505.title: Large-scale Optimization of Partial AUC in a Range of False Positive Rates
arxiv-2203-01505.creator: Yao Yao yao-yao-2@uiowa.edu, Qihang Lin qihang-lin@uiowa.edu, Tianbao Yang tianbao-yang@uiowa.edu
arxiv-2203-01505.description: Abstract The area under the ROC curve (AUC) is one of the most widely used performance measures for classification models in machine learning. However, it summarizes the true positive rates (TPRs) over all false positive rates (FPRs) in the ROC space, which may include the FPRs with no practical relevance in some applications.

arxiv-2210-12888.title: Turán Problems for Mixed Graphs
arxiv-2210-12888.creator: Nitya Mani and Edward Yu
arxiv-2210-12888.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nitya Mani and Edward Yu. We investigate natural Turán problems for mixed graphs, generalizations of graphs where edges can be either directed or undirected. We study a natural Turán density coefficient that measures how large a fraction of directed edges an F F -free mixed graph can have; we establish an analogue of the Erdős-Stone-Simonovits theorem and give a variational characterization of the Turán density coefficient of any mixed graph (along with an associated extremal F F -free family).

arxiv-2211-01531.title: Adaptive sparse grid discontinuous Galerkin method: review and software implementation
arxiv-2211-01531.creator: Juntao Huang, Wei Guo, Yingda Cheng
arxiv-2211-01531.description: Abstract This paper reviews the adaptive sparse grid discontinuous Galerkin (aSG-DG) method for computing high dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) and its software implementation. The C ++ software package called AdaM-DG, implementing the aSG-DG method, is available on Github at https://github.com/JuntaoHuang/adaptive-multiresolution-DG . The package is capable of treating a large class of high dimensional linear and nonlinear PDEs.

arxiv-2301-01083.title: The dipole cross section by the unintegrated gluon distribution at small x x
arxiv-2301-01083.creator: G.R.Boroun
arxiv-2301-01083.description: Abstract We apply a previously developed scheme to consistently include the improved saturation model for the unintegrated gluon distribution (UGD) in order to evaluate, in the framework of k t k_{t} factorization, at small x x at the next-to-leading order (NLO) in α s \alpha_{s} .

arxiv-2301-09380.creator: Alexandros Eskenazis, Piotr Nayar, Tomasz Tkocz
arxiv-2301-09380.description: Abstract . We prove an extension of Szarek’s optimal Khinchin inequality (1976) for distributions close to the Rademacher one, when all the weights are uniformly bounded by a 1 / 2 1/\sqrt{2} fraction of their total ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -mass. We also show a similar extension of the probabilistic formulation of Ball’s cube slicing inequality (1986).

arxiv-2305-11684.creator: Kodjo Mawuena Amekoe 1,3, Mohamed Djallel Dilmi 1,2, Hanene Azzag 1, Mustapha Lebbah 1,2, Zaineb Chelly Dagdia 2 and Gregoire Jaffre 3, 1- Sorbonne Paris Nord University - LIPN, UMR CNRS 7030, Villetaneuse, France, 2- Paris-Saclay University - DAVID Lab, UVSQ, Versailles, France, 3- Groupe BPCE, 7 p
arxiv-2305-11684.description: Abstract Apart from the high accuracy of machine learning models, what interests many researchers in real-life problems (e.g., fraud detection, credit scoring) is to find hidden patterns in data; particularly when dealing with their challenging imbalanced characteristics. Interpretability is also a key requirement that needs to accompany the used machine learning model.

arxiv-2406-04062.title: Online Learning in Betting Markets: Profit versus Prediction
arxiv-2406-04062.creator: Haiqing Zhu, Alexander Soen, Yun Kuen Cheung, Lexing Xie
arxiv-2406-04062.description: Abstract We examine two types of binary betting markets, whose primary goal is for profit (such as sports gambling) or to gain information (such as prediction markets). We articulate the interplay between belief and price-setting to analyse both types of markets, and show that the goals of maximising bookmaker profit and eliciting information are fundamentally incompatible.

arxiv-2407-18422.title: A Black Swan Hypothesis: The Role of Human Irrationality in AI Safety
arxiv-2407-18422.creator: Hyunin Lee Chanwoo Park David Abel Ming Jin
arxiv-2407-18422.description: Abstract Black swan events are statistically rare occurrences that carry extremely high risks. A standard view of black swans assumes that they originate from an unpredictable and changing environment; however, the community lacks a comprehensive definition of black swan events.

arxiv-2601-10642.description: Abstract The study is devoted to comparing the parameters of the interstellar medium of HII regions in the Kongiu and Groves catalogs for the galaxy NGC 628. pmc-10648538.title: Photonic Crystal Surface Modes for Trapping and Waveguiding of Ultracold Atoms
pmc-10648538.creator: Valery Konopsky
pmc-10648538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The design of a photonic system for the trapping and waveguiding of ultracold atoms far above a dielectric surface is proposed and analyzed. The system consists of an optical rib waveguide deposited on a planar one-dimensional photonic crystal, which sustains two wavelengths of photonic crystal surface modes tuned in the red and blue sides relative to the atomic transition of the neutral atom.

pmc-10675615.title: HantaNet: A New MicrobeTrace Application for Hantavirus Classification, Genomic Surveillance, Epidemiology and Outbreak Investigations
pmc-10675615.creator: Roxana Cintron, Shannon L M Whitmer, Evan Moscoso, Ellsworth M Campbell, Reagan Kelly, Emir Talundzic, Melissa Mobley, Kuo Wei Chiu, Elizabeth Shedroff, Anupama Shankar, Joel M Montgomery, John D Klena, William M Switzer, Zeynep Ertem, Jose Luis Herrera Diestra, Yuan Bai, Lin Wang, Zhanwei Du
pmc-10675615.description: Hantaviruses zoonotically infect humans worldwide with pathogenic consequences and are mainly spread by rodents that shed aerosolized virus particles in urine and feces. Bioinformatics methods for hantavirus diagnostics, genomic surveillance and epidemiology are currently lacking a comprehensive approach for data sharing, integration, visualization, analytics and reporting.

pmc-11480681.title: Extra-anatomical Bypass in a Case of Recoarctation and Previous Cardiac Surgery
pmc-11480681.creator: Assen Keltchev, Kristiyanna Mavrodieva, Andrey Neutov, Evgeni V Mekov, Georgi Yankov
pmc-11480681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A complex clinical case of aortic recoarctation is presented. The case is a 61-year-old comorbid patient with two previous aortic and cardiac operations. At the age of 10, the patient underwent surgery for post-ductal coarctation of the aorta (adult type) at the typical site, where the stenotic area was completely resected, and an end-to-end anastomosis was performed through a left-sided thoracotomy.

pmc-11759127.title: FACTORS AFFECTING THE NON-OCCURRENCE OF ORGASM IN SLOVENIAN WOMEN

pmc-11759127.description: SUMMARYSexuality is a complex process, a natural biological human need that is present throughout life. Closely related to sexuality is the sex drive (libido), which is the basis of human sexual activity. An important aspect of sexuality in both sexes is also the experience of orgasm.

pmc-12472207.title: The Impact of Physical Education Attendance and Diet on Bone Mineralization in Adolescents
pmc-12472207.creator: Agata Przytula, Joanna Popiolek-Kalisz
pmc-12472207.description: Background: Bone mineralization can be influenced by physical activity and dietary factors; however, the relative contributions of these factors are not well defined. Physical activity in adolescents can be implemented with physical education (PE) classes and there is no reported data on their impact on bone mineralization.

pmc-12523567.description: PurposeTo analyze the disease burden of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) among Chinese women of reproductive age (WRA) from 1990 to 2021, as well as the projected trends through 2035.Patients and MethodsA segmented regression analysis was carried out to assess the temporal trend of the disease burden.

pmc-12641148.title: Development and Validation of a Nomogram for Predicting Intravenous Amiodarone‐Induced Phlebitis: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-12641148.creator: Jiexia Li, Rui Huang, Chunrong Li, Fujia Qin, Zhishuang Tan, Xiaoyan Lin, Haimin Qin
pmc-12641148.description: BackgroundIntravenous amiodarone is primarily used to treat hemodynamically unstable atrial or ventricular arrhythmias and prevent atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery. However, when administered via peripheral intravenous infusion, the incidence of phlebitis is relatively high. This increase in complication rate not only increases patient discomfort and prolongs hospitalization but may also adversely affect treatment efficacy and quality of life.

pmc-12979454.title: Characterization of ANXA1 in chemotherapy resistance of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: insights from artificial intelligence and integrative bioinformatics analysis
pmc-12979454.creator: Ling Zheng, Haiyan Yang, Yan Cheng, Binxue Xia, Honghui Liu, Hong Xiong
pmc-12979454.description: BackgroundHead and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) exhibits intensive chemoresistance (CR), leading to frequent recurrence and poor prognosis; however, actionable biomarkers and therapeutic options remain limited.MethodsBy utilizing bulk profiles of HNSCC patients (TCGA-HNSCC cohort and GSE6631) from TCGA and GEO databases, we identified CR-associated DEGs via Limma and WGCNA frameworks.

pmc-13162396.title: First-line drug-resistant tuberculosis among children under 15 years in Ethiopia: insights from phenotypic and whole-genome sequencing approaches
pmc-13162396.creator: Yeshiwork Abebaw, Abaysew Ayele, Arash Ghodousi, Dawit Hailu Alemayehu, Gebremedhin Gebremicael, Getu Diriba, Getachew Seid, Andrea Maurizio Cabibbe, Markos Abebe, Anandi Sheth, Rahel Argaw, Woldaregay Erku Abegaz
pmc-13162396.description: BackgroundChildhood drug-resistant tuberculosis is often underdiagnosed and inadequately characterized due to the paucibacillary nature of the disease. This study aimed to assess resistance to first-line anti-tuberculosis drugs in children using phenotypic drug susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing.MethodsA retrospective-prospective study was conducted on culture-confirmed childhood tuberculosis cases in Ethiopia (2017–2023).

pmc-13263570.title: Advancements in sagittal alignment parameters and management of adult spine deformities
pmc-13263570.creator: Jordan A Bauer, Rohan Rajan, Rajendra Singh, Marissa Gedman, Alexander K Hahn, Jason Dacruz, Hanbing Zhou, Cameron Kia
pmc-13263570.description: Adult spinal deformity (ASD) is increasingly recognized as a condition in which sagittal alignment plays a role in pain, disability, and mechanical failure. Historically, sagittal correction strategies relied on global radiographic parameters such as sagittal vertical axis (SVA) and pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis (PI-LL) mismatch.

pmc-13265998.title: Ostrich-derived Bacillus safensis O-6 enhances broiler growth performance by modulating gut microbiota and protein digestibility☆
pmc-13265998.creator: Gege Wang, Yingying Chen, Yuncai Xiao, Mengxin Sun, Xiang Li, Muhammad Akhtar, Yingting You, Xinxin Zhou, Deshi Shi
pmc-13265998.description: In broiler production, the inefficient utilization of dietary protein limits growth performance and wastes resources. Inspired by the high feed conversion efficiency of ostriches, which may host beneficial digestive microbes, this study investigated whether fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) from ostriches could confer advantageous traits to broilers, and further sought to isolate and evaluate potential probiotic.

pmc-13438136.title: Assessing the onset of spring water-level rise in snowmelt-dominated rivers of northeastern Russia using machine learning
pmc-13438136.creator: Ivan Malashin, Igor Masich, Vladimir Nelyub, Aleksei Borodulin, Andrei Gantimurov, Vadim Tynchenko
pmc-13438136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The timing of the initial spring water-level rise represents a key indicator of seasonal hydrological transition in snowmelt-dominated river systems of high-latitude regions. This study evaluates the capability of ensemble machine learning (ML) models to estimate the onset date of the spring water-level rise in Arctic–subarctic rivers of the Anadyr–Kolyma basin district in northeastern Russia using a station-year dataset for the period 2008–2022, combining hydrological observations with meteorological and basin-related predictors. Five regression algorithms were tested using grouped cross-validation by year.

pmc-13658042.title: Palatal Donor‐Site Healing and Patient‐Reported Outcome Measures Following Chitosan and Injectable Platelet‐Rich Fibrin‐Enriched Chitosan Application Compared with Gelatine Sponge: A Three‐Arm Randomised Controlled Clinical Trial
pmc-13658042.creator: Ayse Ege Selman, Bahar Alkaya, Burcu Karaduman, Mustafa Ozcan, Mehmet Cenk Haytac
pmc-13658042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimTo compare clinical outcomes and patient‐reported outcome measures (PROMs) of palatal donor‐site healing following the use of an absorbable gelatine sponge, a chitosan sponge or an injectable platelet‐rich fibrin (i‐PRF)‐enriched chitosan sponge after free gingival graft harvesting.Materials and MethodsIn this three‐arm randomised controlled clinical study, a total of 68 patients were allocated to three groups: i‐PRF + chitosan (n = 22), chitosan (n = 23) and gelatine sponge (control; n = 23). The primary outcome was the palatal early healing index (PEHI).

uslaw-usc-t2-s4335.title: 2 U.S.C. § 4335 — Employment of civilian employees of executive branch of Government by Senate Committee on Appropriations; restoration to former position
uslaw-usc-t2-s4335.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s4335.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 43 (Congressional Committees); Subchapter III (Senate). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever any person has left or leaves any civilian position in any department or agency in the executive branch of the Government in order to accept employment by the Senate Committee on Appropriations, he shall be carried on the rolls of such committee.
